يتهتلر (form IIq)
# يَتَهَتْلَرُ (yatahatlaru) /ja.ta.hat.la.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَهَتْلَرَ (tahatlara)
# يَتَهَتْلَرَ (yatahatlara) /ja.ta.hat.la.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَهَتْلَرَ (tahatlara)
# يَتَهَتْلَرْ (yatahatlar) /ja.ta.hat.lar/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَهَتْلَرَ
